The team’s ambition is simple: people should be able to pay anything, anywhere, with Wise.

Send Convenience is building the experience that makes that possible. From sending money home to paying rent, utilities, and taxes, we’re making Wise the account people can rely on for everyday life across borders.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you’ll build flows and shape the experience 15 million customers use every month. Every unnecessary step you remove and every interaction you improve makes a difference at that scale.

You’ll be the team’s main web contributor, with the autonomy to question a journey, propose a better one, and build it. Working with product, design, and engineering colleagues across Tallinn and London, you’ll help decide what great looks like, and bring it to life.

**What will you be working on?**

* Building better ways to pay bills, from the UK to Australia to Brazil: turning different local payment methods into experiences that feel familiar and easy to use.
* Making everyday sending effortless: removing unnecessary steps, repetitive input, and confusing choices from our send money flow.
* Shaping the product from the start: working with product, design, and research to understand customer problems, test ideas, and decide what to build.

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

### **The Role:**

The team is at the center of Aiven's move into agentic AI. We build the platform and tooling that let AI agents and developers work with data on Aiven, from the agent runtimes and the interfaces that connect large language models to real systems, to the product experiences on top of them. Our work ships fast, reaches customers and AI agents directly, and defines how Aiven's data platform is used in an AI-first world.

We are looking for an experienced full-stack engineer to help design and build these AI and agentic products end to end. You'll be part of a small, senior team that owns its work from idea to production. Our backend services are written in Python and TypeScript, our agents run on frontier LLMs, and our frontend uses React and TypeScript, all on top of Aiven's own data platform.

* Helping investigate and resolve customer issues
* Mentor and empower other engineers around you

* Excellent development skills in Python, TypeScript, and React
* Excellent understanding of Agentic AI systems
* Ability to independently solve challenges, break tasks and push to desired outcome

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

## Your competencies

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need. 

Responsibility

You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

Drive

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. You are the one who takes the piece nobody else can crack and finds a way through, then leaves the ground solid enough for everyone else to build on. Peratera is a UK-based fintech company, founded in 2022 and authorised by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution.

We are building a modern, all-in-one payment platform that enables businesses to manage global payments and financial operations seamlessly.

Our solution allows companies to open multi-currency accounts, send and receive payments worldwide, and manage cross-border transactions from a single platform.

Our mission is to simplify global finance and remove friction from international business operations.

## Your mission

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will be part of the team building and evolving the user-facing applications behind our financial platform.

  

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will develop new functionality, improve existing solutions, and contribute to frontend architecture and technical decisions. # Principal Engineer - Reporting & Insights

* US: Remote / United States
* Hybrid
* Engineering
* R0018130

## The Role

### **About the Role**

Millions of small businesses and their advisors use Xero reports and insights to decide what to do next. AI is changing how people understand their finances faster than any shift since the cloud, and Reporting & Insights is where Xero meets that change. Over the next few years we’re evolving reporting and insights for the agentic era, where customers ask an AI about their numbers as often as they open a Balance Sheet. As the senior technical leader for Reporting & Insights, you’ll set the multi-year technical direction, from the reports businesses file to the insights that tell them what to do next. You’ll also help hire the first Reporting & Insights engineers in Vancouver and decide how they work.

### **The Technical Challenges**

**Set a 3-year architecture across Reporting & Insights.** Reporting and Xero Analytics run on a mix of modern services and systems that have grown with Xero over many years. You’ll define one target state across both, decide how they build on Xero’s data platform, and secure the investment to get there. You’ll design for high throughput, low latency and resilience, so reporting and insights scale with Xero’s largest and most complex customers.

**Evolve the platform without breaking trust.** Accountants file tax returns from these numbers, so correctness comes first. You’ll lead the evolution of the data foundations behind about 150 reports, sequenced across teams and organisational boundaries. Customers keep the numbers they trust, on foundations built for what comes next.

**Make reporting and insights AI-native.** AI changes what reporting and insights can be: answers to plain-language questions, insights that reach customers where they work, and analysis that once took an accountant hours. Every answer still has to reconcile to the ledger. You’ll define the foundations: how agents query financial data safely, how answers stay grounded and explainable, and how we prove correctness at scale. We want teams across Xero to build on what you create.

### **Impact**

In your **first six months** you’ll own the Reporting & Insights architecture and set a direction for the data platform and the evolution of both products that engineering, Product and leadership back.

**At twelve months you will have:**

* Set a multi-year technical strategy for Reporting & Insights
* Delivered new foundations for the first major report families, setting Reporting & Insights up for its next phase of growth
* Opened Reporting & Insights to bigger businesses, with performance that scales to our largest customers
* Put shared foundations for AI-native reporting and insights into production
* Grown the Lead and Senior Engineers around you and raised the technical bar across the group

Beyond year one, you’ll shape where Reporting & Insights goes next, and help steer Xero’s wider data and AI directi

title: Contentsquare - Staff Product Designer, AI
content:
## Staff Product Designer, AI

Raleigh, North Carolina

Engineering, Product, and Design – All Engineering, Product, and Design Roles /

Full-time /

Remote

Apply for this job

Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

*Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.*

Contentsquare works with 3,000+ enterprise and mid-market brands on data from 1.3 million websites. We've raised $1.4bn to build the platform, and G2 rates us a Leader across ten enterprise categories. Sense is our agentic layer on top of that: ten years of cross-customer behavioural data, an AI analyst, a chat and visual-stories interface, and a memory and object model underneath both.

This role leads design for Sense's core AI surfaces as a product in its own right, not a feature downstream of someone else's roadmap. That means owning strategy and vision for this surface, not just shipping against a brief. Most of what you're designing here has no reference pattern to draw from yet; part of the job is defining and sharing these patterns.

### What you'll do

* Own design for Sense Analyst, the object model, and the inline visualisations it returns, from problem framing through to shipped detail.
* Lead the experience strategy and vision for this product surface, and shape its roadmap alongside Product Management.
* Work from the data model up: what counts as a persistent object, how memory and context carry across sessions, and how that surfaces to the person using it.
* Set the quality bar for AI-generated output on these surfaces: what "trustworthy" and "good" look like, and how that gets versioned and evaluated with engineering.
* Partner with engineering on customer facing agentic workflows and how AI-generated output gets versioned and trusted.
* Work alongside the other designers building the AI-native parts of the product: review each other's work, push each other's thinking, and help less-senior designers on the team build judgement in this space.
